messages:
sarah: Heads up — PM asked if we can stop shipping full raw debug traces to the external SIEM for triage. They want a minimized export so partner analysts can do vuln triage without raw PII. What options do we have? @alex @morgan

alex: short: introduce an 'analyst-lite' export with field-level redaction + tokenized user ids. Keep original raw retained internally for SRE only. :thinking_face:

morgan: Agree. Two parts: 1) export pipeline redaction (remove headers, ip, user agent), 2) RBAC change: new role that only sees redacted streams. Also need audit logs for who requested exports.

tess: Question on KMS: if we redact and then export to partner SIEM, do we need to rewrap with a partner CMK? or can we use envelope encryption with our CMK + partner public key? cc @security-crypto

sarah: Good point. Also timeline: PM wants this for upcoming audit next month. We need a playbook: request template, automated scrub + reviewer approval, and TTL on exported snapshots.

alex: Implementation sketch:
```
pipeline: redact -> tokenize(user_id) -> sign_metadata -> encrypt(envelope, our-cmk) -> export
access: analyst-lite role via OPA policy -> no raw access
audit: export-record -> ticket-id -> auditor-email
```
We should add a 7-day expiry on partner SIEM ingests.

morgan: For RBAC changes: propose terraform change to create role 'siem_analyst_lite' with conditions: scope=project, can_read=redacted_logs, cannot_read=raw_logs, require 2FA. Also backlog a migration script to reassign existing service accounts.

tess: On KMS: vendor SIEM integrations sometimes require keys on their side. I'd prefer we push encrypted blobs and let vendors keep them encrypted until we approve key unwrap. Rewrap-on-request is safest.

sarah: :thumbsup: sounds reasonable. Need to capture it in playbook. Can someone draft the request template and a short runbook for oncall approval?

alex: I'll draft the runbook + terraform snippet. Will ping the infra team about CMK policy for rewrap (principal: siem-ingest-service).

morgan: I'll draft the RBAC PR and add a CI check ensuring exports cannot reference raw_log_index.*

secops-bot: Policy change detected: siem-export-constraints v0.2 created in docs repo by alex. Link: https://git.internal/docs/siem-export-constraints

sarah: Great. Added to audit checklist. For the ticket format, use: 'export:<project>:<start>-<end>:reason:approver' — that will help automated correlation.

tess: One more: need SIG approval for partner access. I'll open the PR for partner onboarding checklist. Also propose 30-day retention on exported snapshots and auto-delete.

sarah: OK meeting with PM tomorrow to confirm. If we agree, target rollout next Thursday (small pilot with one partner).
